title: Interaction with Dr. S. Jaishankar – External Affairs Minister of India
summary: A distinguished gathering at the Embassy of India, Kuwait, bringing together members of the Indian community for an interaction with India's External Affairs Minister, Dr. S. Jaishankar.
description:
On 8 July 2026, the Embassy of India in Kuwait hosted a special interaction with Dr. S. Jaishankar, India's External Affairs Minister, bringing together representatives from various sections of the Indian community.

The gathering provided a meaningful opportunity for community representatives to engage with India's leadership, reflecting the enduring connection between India and its diaspora in Kuwait.

The occasion highlighted the importance of community participation, dialogue and the continuing relationship between the Indian Embassy and the Indian community.

A memorable and distinguished encounter, representing another meaningful chapter in a journey of community engagement and service.
